description: Run SELECT-only SQL against a DataCanvas table populated by socrata_query_dataset. Columns SODA types as number (including aggregate aliases like count(*) as n) are staged as DOUBLE, so numeric comparisons work without a cast (year > 2020, amount < 500). Text and timestamp columns stay VARCHAR — compare times with CAST(date AS TIMESTAMP). Works when the server has a DataCanvas. Use socrata_dataframe_describe to see registered tables and their schemas.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID returned from socrata_query_dataset or socrata_dataframe_describe.

limit.description: Max rows to return (1–50,000). One call returns at most 10,000 rows: a larger limit is served as 10,000, with a notice naming how to page through the rest when more rows match. Default 1000.

sql.description: SELECT-only SQL to run against registered canvas tables. DDL, DML, file paths, file-reading functions, and any name spelled like a DuckDB metadata view (pg_type, duckdb_tables, sqlite_master), even as a column alias or CTE name, are rejected. Use table names from socrata_dataframe_describe.

name: socrata_dataframe_query

cap.description: The row limit that was applied when capped.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_disabled`: CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE is not set to duckdb — DataCanvas is unavailable. `canvas_not_found`: canvas_id does not match any registered canvas. `table_not_found`: The SQL referenced a canvas table that does not exist — expired, dropped, or a mistyped name. `sql_rejected`: SQL was not a single SELECT statement, named a file or a system catalog (a column alias or CTE spelled like a DuckDB metadata view counts), or contained disallowed functions or operators. data.gateReason carries the canvas gate's own reason. `invalid_sql`: A SELECT failed to parse or prepare: a syntax error, or a column, function, or type the canvas does not have. data.binderMessage carries the engine detail. `sql_execution_error`: A SELECT prepared but failed while it ran over the staged rows: a failed CAST, an out-of-range value, or a function argument rejected at run time (a zero step in range). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance for this page: how to adjust the SQL when it returned zero rows, or how to reach the rest when rows were capped, naming the requested and served limit when a limit above the 10,000-row per-call cap was served as 10,000. Absent otherwise.

rows.description: Query result rows. DuckDB may return native JS types (number, boolean, null) for numeric/boolean columns.

shown.description: Rows returned in this response when capped.

truncated.description: True when results were capped at the limit — more rows match the query.

title: Query DataCanvas Table
